panel.title: Aurora
panel.aiNotice: You are talking with Aurora, an AI assistant. It answers only from records you can see and never changes anything without your confirmation.
panel.inputHelp: Press Enter to ask. Shift+Enter adds a line.
panel.asking: Aurora is reading the records you can see.
panel.loadingStatus: Checking what Aurora can do for you.

empty.sentence: Ask about projects, permits, crew, schedules or vendors. Aurora answers from records you can see and links to each one.

off.sentence: An Admin has not turned on the assistant for this org.
off.actionMember: Ask an Admin to turn it on in Settings, AI Features.

notInPlan.title: Aurora AI is not in your plan
notInPlan.reason: Aurora AI comes with the Core, Pro, Team and Enterprise plans. An Owner can change the plan in Settings, Billing and Plan.

limit.title: This month's Aurora allowance is used up
limit.reason: Your org has used all {allowance, number} requests this month. The allowance resets on the first of next month, or an Owner can move to a larger plan.

statusError.title: Aurora could not load
statusError.sentence: We could not check what Aurora can do for you. Check your connection and try again.

failed.title: Aurora could not answer
failed.sentence: The model did not respond, and nothing was changed. Ask again in a moment.

error.title: Aurora could not be reached
error.sentence: Check your connection and ask again. Nothing was changed.

suggestions.heading: Waiting for your confirmation
suggestions.caption: Proposed values
suggestions.applied: Applied. The change was written with your permissions.
suggestions.error: This proposed change could not be loaded: {detail}

settings.title: Aurora AI features
settings.description: Every Aurora AI feature is off until an Admin turns it on. Restricted fields and medical records are never sent to a model, and customer data is never used for training.
settings.readOnly: Only people who manage AI features can change these switches.
settings.notInPlan: Aurora AI is not in this org's plan. An Owner can move to Core or above in Settings, Billing and Plan to turn features on.
settings.usage: {used, number} of {allowance, number} requests used this month.
settings.usageUnlimited: {used, number} requests this month. Your plan sets no monthly limit.
settings.loadFailed: AI features could not load. Reload the page to try again.

errors.aurora_not_in_plan: Aurora AI is not in this org's plan, so features cannot be turned on.
errors.generic: The features were not saved. Try again.

assistant.label: Assistant
assistant.description: Answers questions about your records with links to them. Cmd or Ctrl+J in Atlas, the More menu in Compass.

plain_language.label: Ask in plain language
plain_language.description: Turns a sentence into a saved view or filter and shows the filter it built.

extraction.label: Document extraction
extraction.description: Reads riders, insurance certificates, invoices, receipts and quotes into fields for you to confirm.

drafting.label: Drafting
drafting.description: Drafts SOPs, advance packets, emails, day sheets and change order descriptions in your verbiage.

summaries.label: Summaries
summaries.description: Summarizes a record's activity, a project's week and gate readiness.

mapping.label: Mapping help
mapping.description: Suggests import column mappings and catalog bindings for unknown scanned codes.

extraction.noAnswer: Aurora could not read any field from this document: {missing}
extraction.failed: Aurora could not read the document. Nothing was changed. Try again.
extraction.review: Review the lines Aurora read before saving them.
extraction.fileHelp: A PDF, image or text file of the rider, up to 10 MB.
extraction.tooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB. Choose a smaller file.
extraction.saved: Rider lines added from the document.
extraction.suggestionsOpen: The lines were added, but some proposals are still open in the suggestion log.
extraction.saveFailed: The lines were not saved. Check the rider and try again.
extraction.noLines: Aurora found no asks in this rider. Add them by hand above.

compass.menuDescription: Ask about your shifts, SOPs and handbook.
